SELECT 
    sr.logregistry AS registration_id,
    sr.arcref AS project_id,
    sr.logaccumm AS accuracy_measurements,
    sr.errvalmm AS error_values,
    (sr.logaccumm / sr.errvalmm) AS calculated_ratio
FROM 
    scanregistration AS sr;
```

This PostgreSQL `SELECT` statement retrieves specific columns from the `scanregistration` table, aliasing them for clarity and performing a calculation on two of the columns. The result includes the registration ID, project ID, accuracy measurements, error values, and a calculated ratio of accuracy measurements to error values. The query is already well-formatted and does not require further canonicalization.
